items.description: If the SPV Lease is rejected or disaffirmed by SPV Tenant or its bankruptcy trustee, Guarantor must assume SPV Tenant's obligations under the SPV Lease when Landlord requests.
items.span_text: Guarantor will, if Landlord so requests, assume all obligations and liabilities of SPV Tenant under the SPV Lease
items.trigger: in the event of the rejection or disaffirmance of the SPV Lease by SPV Tenant or SPV Tenant’s trustee in bankruptcy

items.description: Guarantor must confirm its assumption of the SPV Lease obligations in writing when Landlord asks, upon or after the rejection or disaffirmance.
items.span_text: Guarantor will confirm such assumption, in writing, at the request of Landlord upon or after such rejection or disaffirmance.
items.trigger: at the request of Landlord upon or after such rejection or disaffirmance

items.description: Before the Springing Event Trigger Date, SPV Tenant must keep at least one independent manager or director whose qualifications comply with its governance documents.
items.span_text: Prior to the Springing Event Trigger Date, the SPV Tenant shall maintain at least one “independent manager” or “independent director”

items.description: Guarantor gives an absolute and unconditional guaranty of payment and performance that is enforceable without Landlord first pursuing SPV Tenant or giving notices.
items.span_text: This Guaranty is an absolute and unconditional guaranty of payment and of performance, and not of collection

items.description: If a payment under the SPV Lease or Guaranty is rescinded or must be returned by Landlord, Guarantor must pay Landlord the equivalent amount.
items.span_text: Guarantor shall pay to Landlord an amount equal to any such payment that has been rescinded or returned.
items.trigger: if at any time the payment of any amount due under the SPV Lease or this Guaranty is rescinded or must otherwise be returned by Landlord for any reason
